$comment: Output map: which columns an output receives, read from the item. Template kind: output-map. "from" is an SI field, record.<name> (a value of the item), or a system token ($run_id, $run_time, $row_hash, $changed_at, $const:<value>). "op" is from the closed output operation set. Customer overrides: outputs/<id>.custom.json (add, remove or rename columns; a column keeps its place unless moved).
description: ServiceNow remediation task links (Import Set): one row per task and finding it resolves (many-to-many: one finding can belong to several tasks). u_source_record_id is the vulnerable item's own record id (<CI key>|<finding>), unchanged. The SQL hand-off view snowstage.vImportRemediationTaskFinding carries the same columns, the same row hash and source run. Every date UTC 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'; u_changed_at is when its task last changed. Key u_si_task_id + u_vulnerability. Column names are a contract; append only.
